symptoms: Fever, cough, purulent sputum, pleuritic chest pain, dyspnoea, focal consolidation on chest x-ray
CURB-65 Score: Confusion (1), Urea > 7 (1), RR >= 30 (1), SBP < 90 or DBP <= 60 (1), Age >= 65 (1).

management_steps.details: Outpatient treatment: Augmentin 375mg PO + Amoxil 500mg PO x 5 days + Erythromycin 500mg PO QID x 5 days.
Inpatient treatment: Augmentin 1.2g IV STAT +/- Azithromycin 500mg PO/IV.
Severe pneumonia treatment: Augmentin 1.2g IV STAT OR Zinacef 1.5g IV STAT + Azithromycin 500mg PO/IV + Hydrocortisone 100mg IVI STAT.
